item.title: Malicious Complainants to Face Institutions, Not Individual Civil Servants… Verbal Abuse and Assault to Be Reported (악성 민원인, 이제 공무원 개인 아닌 기관이 상대… 폭언·폭행은 고발)
item.description:
Malicious Complainants to Face Institutions, Not Individual Civil Servants… Verbal Abuse and Assault to Be Reported (악성 민원인, 이제 공무원 개인 아닌 기관이 상대… 폭언·폭행은 고발)

The government has decided that so-called "malicious complainants"—those who repeatedly file complaints without just cause or engage in verbal abuse and assault—will be handled at the institutional level, rather than by individual civil servants. (정당한 사유 없이 민원을 반복해서 제기하거나 폭언·폭행을 일삼는 이른바 ‘악성 민원인’에 대해 정부가 공무원 개인이 아니라 기관 차원에서 대응하기로 했다.)

The Anti-Corruption and Civil Rights Commission (ACRC) and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety (MOIS) announced on the 11th: "We are fully revamping the complaint response system to reduce administrative waste caused by indiscriminate, repetitive, and unusual complaints, and to protect civil servants handling complaints." (국민권익위원회와 행정안전부는 11일 “일부 무분별한 반복·특이 민원으로 인한 행정력 낭비를 줄이고 민원 담당 공무원을 보호하기 위해 민원 대응 체계를 전면 개편한다”고 밝혔다.)

The ACRC and MOIS stated that while individual civil servants have previously handled repetitive and unusual complaints, going forward, each institution will be responsible for responding to these matters at the organizational level as a matter of principle. (권익위와 행안부는 그동안은 정부 공무원 개개인이 반복·특이 민원에 대응해 왔으나, 앞으로는 각 기관이 기관 차원에서 책임지고 대응하는 것을 원칙으로 하겠다고 했다.)

The government will designate a "Conflict Mediation Officer" within each institution's senior organizational unit, who will be tasked exclusively with responding to repetitive and unusual complaints. This officer will also protect affected civil servants and educate other employees on complaint response methods. Complaints involving multiple agencies will be transferred to and managed by the ACRC. (정부는 기관마다 직제상 선임 부서에 ‘갈등조정담당관’을 두고, 반복·특이 민원 대응은 이 갈등조정담당관이 도맡아 하기로 했다. 갈등조정담당관은 피해 공무원을 보호하고, 다른 공무원들에게 민원 대응법을 교육하는 역할도 맡는다. 여러 기관이 얽혀 있는 민원은 권익위가 넘겨받아 관리한다.)

If a complainant engages in illegal acts—such as verbal abuse, assault, threats against civil servants, or property damage—the institution will file a criminal complaint or report against the complainant at the organizational level. Affected civil servants will receive administrative, legal, and medical support. To this end, each institution is mandated to allocate a budget for legal responses against malicious complainants. (민원인이 공무원에게 폭언·폭행·협박을 하거나 기물을 파손하는 등 위법 행위를 할 경우에는 기관 차원에서 해당 민원인을 고소·고발하기로 했다. 피해 공무원에게는 행정·법률·의료 지원을 제공한다. 이를 위해 각 기관은 악성 민원인에게 법적 대응을 하기 위한 예산을 의무적으로 편성하기로 했다.)

Additionally, the government plans to introduce an "AI Clean Bot" into the complaint processing system to automatically filter out complaints containing profanity, threats, or sexual harassment from those submitted online. It will also push for amendments to the Complaint Handling Act to restrict the use of electronic complaint channels for individuals who submit a large volume of complaints online within a short period. (정부는 또 민원 처리 시스템에 ‘인공지능(AI) 클린봇’을 도입해, 온라인으로 들어온 민원 가운데 욕설이나 협박, 성희롱이 들어 있는 민원을 자동으로 걸러내기로 했다. 민원처리법 개정도 추진해, 온라인으로 단기간에 민원을 대량으로 내는 사람 등은 전자 민원 창구 이용을 제한하기로 했다.)

MOIS Minister Youn Ho-jung stated, "We must not leave the response to repetitive and unusual complaints solely to the endurance of individual civil servants," adding, "While legitimate complaints will be guaranteed, we will ensure that institutions respond responsibly to acts that disrupt normal complaint processing, thereby protecting both civil servants and the public." (윤호중 행안부 장관은 “반복·특이 민원 대응을 공무원 개인의 인내에만 맡겨서는 안 된다”며 “정당한 민원은 보장하되, 정상적인 민원 처리를 방해하는 행위에는 기관이 책임 있게 대응해 공무원과 국민 모두를 보호하겠다”고 했다.)

ACRC Chairman Jeong Il-yeon said, "Centralizing the response window for repetitive and unusual complaints in each institution has elevated the role of the Conflict Mediation Officer," and added, "We will actively support these officers so they can effectively handle repetitive and unusual complaints on a full-time basis." (정일연 권익위원장은 “각 기관의 반복·특이 민원 대응 창구 일원화로 갈등조정담당관의 역할이 중요해졌다”며 “담당관이 실질적으로 반복·특이 민원을 전담 처리할 수 있게 적극적으로 지원하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Election Commission: "Over 42,000 Ballot Papers Left Over in Songpa-gu... Distribution Failure" (선관위 “송파구 투표용지 4만2000여매 남아…분배 실패”)
item.description:
Election Commission: "Over 42,000 Ballot Papers Left Over in Songpa-gu... Distribution Failure" (선관위 “송파구 투표용지 4만2000여매 남아…분배 실패”)

Woo Cheol-hwan, acting chair of the National Election Commission, stated on the 11th, "Looking at the entire Songpa-gu area, over 42,000 ballot papers remained," and added, "Failing to distribute ballot papers across the 146 polling stations in Songpa-gu was a painful mistake." Regarding the decision to set the lower limit for printing regular ballot papers at 50%, he explained, "There were concerns about loss or theft, and we have been plagued by allegations of election fraud." <<> In a public statement released that day, Acting Chair Woo said, "The overall printing rate for ballots in (Songpa-gu) was 73.3%, and the overall voter turnout in Songpa-gu was 65.8%." <<> Acting Chair Woo expressed, "I offer my heartfelt apologies for the ballot paper shortage that infringed on the people's right to vote," and added, "Since the public has many pressing questions about the ballot shortage during this local election, I would like to briefly explain the key points." <<> Regarding the decision to set the lower limit for printing regular ballot papers (excluding early voting) at 50% ahead of this election, Acting Chair Woo stated, "Originally, the lower limit was 60%, but after the last election, the surplus ballot papers increased, leading to difficulties in inspection and storage of millions of ballots, as well as concerns about loss, theft, and seizure. In particular, printing an excessive number of ballots relative to the election day turnout rate led to allegations of election fraud. Additionally, there were persistent appeals from the field about the need to lower the limit in areas with rising early voting rates and falling election day voting rates, as well as difficulties in securing printing facilities due to the short printing period." <<> He added, "In response, the Election Commission commissioned a policy research project with the Korea Institute of Public Administration in 2022. Based on the findings of a task force composed of field staff, the lower limit for printing regular ballot papers was adjusted downward to 50% in the comprehensive management guidelines for the 9th nationwide simultaneous local elections and the public official election procedure manual. However, the final printing ratio was left to the discretion of each of the 255 district, city, and county election commissions, taking into account local circumstances and characteristics." <<> The comprehensive management guidelines for the 9th nationwide simultaneous local elections were finalized by the Chief of the Secretariat, and the public official election procedure manual was finalized by the Director of the Election Policy Office, both bypassing the commissioners of the National Election Commission. <<> Acting Chair Woo stated, "An external fact-finding committee is conducting a rigorous investigation, and we expect the full truth to be revealed through future investigations by law enforcement agencies and parliamentary audits. I once again apologize for the damage to the people's right to vote, and we will proceed with follow-up measures, fully recognizing that even a single person's voting right must never be violated." <<> Acting Chair Woo is a classmate of President Lee Jae-myung from the 18th class of the Judicial Research and Training Institute. He was appointed as a standing commissioner of the Election Commission in January after a parliamentary hearing. During the hearing, the People Power Party called for his resignation, citing his past roles as head of the Ethics Tribunal of the Democratic Party of Korea and his public support for President Lee during the presidential election. Since former Supreme Court justice Noh Tae-ak resigned as chair on the 8th, taking responsibility for the incident, Woo has been serving as acting chair. (위철환 중앙선거관리위원회 위원장 직무대행은 11일 “실제 송파구 전체로 보면 투표용지가 4만2000여 매가 남았다”며 “송파구 내 146개 투표소별 투표용지 분배에 실패한 것이 뼈아픈 실수였다”고 했다. 본투표용지 인쇄 비율 하한선을 50%로 결정한 배경에 대해선 “분실·도난 우려가 있었고, 부정선거 의혹 제기에 시달렸다”고 설명했다.)

item.title: Han Byung-do: "Even if We Stay Up All Night, Speed Up the Assembly Formation" Jeong Jeom-sik: "The Giant Ruling Party Must Yield" (한병도 “날 새서라도 빨리 원 구성” 정점식 “거대 여당이 양보해야”)
item.description:
Han Byung-do: "Even if We Stay Up All Night, Speed Up the Assembly Formation" Jeong Jeom-sik: "The Giant Ruling Party Must Yield" (한병도 “날 새서라도 빨리 원 구성” 정점식 “거대 여당이 양보해야”)

On the 11th, Democratic Party floor leader Han Byung-do and new People Power Party floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik met and engaged in a war of nerves over the formation of the second half of the 22nd National Assembly. (더불어민주당 한병도 원내대표와 국민의힘 정점식 신임 원내대표가 11일 만나 22대 국회 후반기 원(院) 구성을 놓고 신경전을 벌였다.)

Jeong, elected at the People Power Party's general meeting of lawmakers the previous day, paid a courtesy visit to Han at the National Assembly that morning. Han presented a congratulatory orchid and offered a compliment, saying, "Floor Leader Jeong is known to have excellent character in both the ruling and opposition parties, to be reasonable, and to be skilled at working while empathizing and communicating with many lawmakers." He added, "While we may compete with each other as we work, I hope we can put our heads together and communicate often." Jeong responded, "I too am well aware that Floor Leader Han has an easygoing and amiable personality," and said, "As I take my first steps, I think it will be an opportunity for me to learn a lot from Floor Leader Han." (전날 국민의힘 의원총회에서 선출된 정 원내대표는 이날 오전 국회에서 한 원내대표를 예방했다. 한 원내대표는 축하 난(蘭)을 건네며 “정 원내대표님은 여야에서 인품이 아주 훌륭하고, 합리적이고, 많은 의원과 교감하고 소통하시며 업무를 잘하시는 분으로 정평이 나 있다”는 덕담을 건넸다. 이어 “일하다 보면 서로 경쟁도 하겠지만, 언제든 머리 맞대고 소통을 많이 했으면 하는 바람”이라고 했다. 정 원내대표는 “저 역시 한 원내대표님이 소탈하시고 원만하신 성격이라는 것을 잘 알고 있다”며 “첫걸음을 떼는 저로서는 한 원내대표님께 많은 것을 배울 기회가 될 것이라고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Han then said, "With people's livelihoods being tough due to issues like the National Election Commission's problems and the situation in the Middle East, I hope that even if the ruling and opposition parties clash, we can quickly form the assembly, work together, and strive to make the National Assembly one that earns the people's assessment as effective and efficient." (한 원내대표는 이어 “선거관리위원회 문제, 중동 상황 등으로 민생이 만만치 않으니 여야가 날을 세우더라도 빨리 원 구성을 해서 일하는 모습, 효능감 있는 모습으로 국민께 평가받는 국회가 되도록 함께 머리를 맞대고 노력했으면 좋겠다”고 했다.)

In response, Jeong countered, "I fully agree that the assembly formation needs to be done quickly. If we move swiftly, an agreement could be reached in just a day or two," adding, "I think it would be possible if Floor Leader Han of the Democratic Party, which holds a huge majority, makes many concessions." (그러자 정 원내대표는 “원 구성을 빨리 해야 한다는 데 전적으로 동의한다. 빨리 하면 하루 이틀 만에도 합의할 수 있다”며 “거대 의석을 가진 민주당의 한 원내대표께서 많은 양보를 해주시면 될 수 있으리라고 생각한다”고 응수했다.)

Earlier that morning at the party's Supreme Council meeting, Jeong had said, "The Democratic Party must restore the convention of checks and balances, where the speaker of the National Assembly is from the largest party and the chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee is from the second-largest party," and demanded "the second-largest party be given the chairmanship of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee in the second-half assembly formation." (정 원내대표는 앞서 이날 오전 당 최고위원회의에서는 “민주당은 ‘국회의장은 1당, 법제사법위원장은 2당’이라는 견제와 균형의 관례를 복원해야 한다”며 “후반기 원 구성에서 법사위원장을 2당 몫으로 내놓으라”고 했다.)

Both sides spoke in unison about uncovering the truth behind the ballot shortage incident during the June 3 local elections. Han said, "There is no disagreement between the ruling and opposition parties on conducting a parliamentary investigation into the National Election Commission's poor election management, uncovering the truth, punishing those responsible, and carrying out legal and institutional reforms to prevent a recurrence." (양측은 6·3 지방선거에서 벌어진 투표용지 부족 사태에 대한 진상 규명에는 한목소리를 냈다. 한 원내대표는 “선거관리위원회의 부실한 (선거) 관리에 대한 국정조사와 진상을 규명하고 책임자를 처벌하며 다시는 이런 일이 없게 법적·제도적인 개혁을 하자는 데 여야 이견이 없다”고 했다.)

Jeong remarked, "It is highly unusual for both parties to agree on a parliamentary investigation even before the second-half assembly formation is completed," adding, "This is because both parties view the ballot shortage incident as that serious." He continued, "We must identify the facts through the parliamentary investigation, hold the National Election Commission accountable where necessary, and promptly address any demands." (정 원내대표는 “후반기 원 구성도 되기 전에 양당이 국정조사에 합의한 것은 굉장히 이례적”이라며 “양당 모두 투표용지 부족 사태를 그만큼 심각하게 생각하기 때문”이라고 했다. 이어 “국정조사를 통해 진상을 파악하고, 선관위에 책임을 물을 것이 있으면 묻고, 요구할 것이 있으면 신속하게 해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "AI Data Centers Would Be More Advantageous if Built Outside the Capital Region" (김용범 “AI 데이터센터, 비수도권에 들어서는 게 유리”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom: "AI Data Centers Would Be More Advantageous if Built Outside the Capital Region" (김용범 “AI 데이터센터, 비수도권에 들어서는 게 유리”)

Kim Yong-beom, head of the Office of the President's Policy Coordination, emphasized the organic connection between the semiconductor and AI industries, stating that it would be advantageous to establish related facilities in non-capital regions. (김용범 청와대 정책실장이 반도체와 AI 산업 간 유기적인 연결을 강조하며 비수도권 지역에 관련 설비를 마련하는 것이 유리하다고 밝혔다.)

In a Facebook post on the 11th, Kim noted that the biggest stumbling block for 'AI data center' investment is 'electricity,' adding, "It is advantageous for such centers to be located in non-capital regions with surplus power or in proximity to power generation facilities." Citing examples of major AI hubs like Virginia in the U.S., Dublin in Ireland, and Singapore facing power shortages, he argued that if AI data centers are built in non-capital areas near power sources, it would reduce the burden on transmission networks. (김 실장은 11일 페이스북을 통해 ‘AI 데이터 센터’ 투자에서 가장 크게 발목 잡는 게 ‘전력’이라며 “전력이 남거나 발전 설비와 가까운 비수도권에 (센터가) 들어서는 것이 유리하다”고 했다. 미국 버지니아나 아일랜드 더블린, 싱가포르 같은 주요 AI 거점이 전력난을 겪고 있다는 점을 예로 들며, AI 데이터센터가 전력 산지인 비수도권에 생기면 송전망 부담이 준다고 본 것이다.)

Kim also viewed building data centers outside the capital favorably from the perspective of balanced regional development. "AI data centers act as a catalyst to drive regional growth and investment," he said. "If they settle in local areas, they become hubs for local industries and tax revenue." He added that even if the number of on-site workers at a data center itself is not large, the surrounding industries would become activated, with various partner companies clustering around the data center. (김 실장은 지역 균형 발전 차원에서도 비수도권에 데이터센터를 짓는 걸 긍정적으로 봤다. 김 실장은 “AI 데이터 센터는 그 지역의 발전과 투자를 끌어오는 마중물이 된다”며 “이들이 지역에 자리 잡으면 지역 산업과 세수의 거점이 된다”고 했다. 데이터센터 자체 상주 인력은 많지 않더라도 그 주변에 형성되는 산업이 활성화된다며 각종 협력사가 데이터센터를 중심으로 모여든다는 것이다.)

Meanwhile, Kim emphasized not only data centers but also the integration of 'physical AI' such as robots and the semiconductor manufacturing industry. He pointed out that while the global division of labor had previously seen the U.S. handle software and model design, Taiwan produce advanced semiconductors, and China handle large-scale manufacturing, the recent geopolitical risks and U.S.-China decoupling have been shaking the AI supply chain. (한편 김 실장은 데이터센터뿐 아니라 로봇과 같은 ‘피지컬 AI’, 반도체 제조 산업과의 결합도 함께 강조했다. 그동안 소프트웨어와 모델 설계는 미국이, 첨단 반도체 생산은 대만이, 대규모 제조는 중국이 맡는 식으로 돌아갔지만, 최근 지정학적 리스크와 미·중 디커플링으로 AI 공급망이 흔들리는 문제를 지적한 것이다.)

Kim evaluated South Korea as a country equipped with semiconductors, power infrastructure, and advanced manufacturing technology all at once, stressing that "linking semiconductors, data centers, and physical AI into a single circular structure to make it a key hub in the AI supply chain" should be a next-generation national strategy. (김 실장은 한국을 반도체와 전력 인프라, 첨단 제조 기술을 한꺼번에 갖춘 국가로 평가하며 “반도체·데이터센터·피지컬 AI를 하나의 순환 구조로 묶어 AI 공급망의 핵심 거점으로 만드는 일”을 차세대 국가 전략으로 강조했다.)

item.title: President Lee: “Expand economic cooperation with the U.S., strengthen independent capabilities in security” (李대통령 “경제는 美와 협력 확대, 안보는 독자역량 강화”)
item.description:
President Lee: “Expand economic cooperation with the U.S., strengthen independent capabilities in security” (李대통령 “경제는 美와 협력 확대, 안보는 독자역량 강화”)

President Lee Jae-myung, currently on a state visit to Italy, stated in an interview with the Italian daily Corriere della Sera published on the 11th (local time) that regarding South Korea's economic and diplomatic course, he will expand economic cooperation with the United States while enhancing “independent operational capabilities” to take responsibility for security in the defense sector. President Lee said, “This is fully aligned with what the U.S. expects from its allies,” adding, “From this perspective, the Korean government is pushing for the recovery of wartime operational control and increased defense investment.” (이탈리아를 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 11일(현지 시각) 공개된 이탈리아 일간지 ‘코리에레 델라 세라’와 인터뷰에서, 한국의 경제·외교 노선에 대해 미국과 경제 협력을 확대하되, 안보 분야에선 스스로 안보를 책임지는 ‘독자적 행동 역량’을 강화하겠다고 말했다. 이 대통령은 “이는 미국이 동맹국에 바라는 방향과도 완전히 일치한다”며 “이러한 관점에서 한국 정부는 전시작전통제권 환수와 국방 투자 확대를 추진하고 있다”고 했다.)

In the interview, President Lee said, “For a long time, South Korea’s foreign policy has been described by the formula ‘security with the U.S., economy with China,’ but given changes in the international and geopolitical environment, this dichotomous approach is no longer valid,” and “We aim to develop a new approach based on national interests.” (이 대통령은 인터뷰에서 “오랫동안 ‘안보는 미국, 경제는 중국(안미경중·安美經中)’이라는 공식으로 설명되어 왔지만, 국제·지정학적 환경 변화를 고려할 때 이러한 이분법적 접근은 더 이상 유효하지 않다”며 “국익에 기반한 새로운 접근법을 발전시키고자 한다”고 했다.)

President Lee noted, “China is South Korea’s major trading partner and plays an indispensable and critical role in our supply chains.” At the same time, he said, “Expanding economic cooperation with the U.S., particularly in the most advanced technology sectors, is a key factor in strengthening our industrial competitiveness and promoting economic growth.” This emphasized collaboration with the U.S., which is at the forefront of cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI). (이 대통령은 “(중국은) 한국의 주요 교역국이자 공급망에 있어 없어서는 안 될 중요한 역할을 하는 나라”라고 했다. 그러면서도 “가장 발전된 기술 분야를 중심으로 미국과 경제 협력을 확대하는 것은 우리 산업의 경쟁력을 강화하고 경제 성장을 도모하는 데 중요한 요소”라고 했다. 인공지능(AI) 등 최첨단 기술의 가장 선두 자리에 있는 미국과 협력을 강조한 것이다.)

Regarding security, President Lee stated, “The alliance with the U.S. remains a core pillar of South Korea’s foreign policy,” adding, “While deepening and advancing this alliance, we also seek to strengthen our independent operational capabilities and promote a broad network of partnerships with other countries.” This indicates a plan to boost defense capabilities and cooperate with multiple nations without relying solely on the U.S. (이 대통령은 안보 분야에 대해선 “미국과의 동맹은 여전히 한국 외교 정책의 핵심 축”이라면서 “동맹을 더욱 심화·발전시키는 한편, 우리의 독자적 행동 역량을 강화하고 다른 국가들과 광범위한 파트너십 네트워크를 증진하고자 한다”고 했다. 미국에만 의존하지 않고 국방력을 키우면서 다른 여러 국가들과 협력하겠다는 것이다.)

On North Korea policy, he said, “Our government has a clear and firm vision to open an era of ‘peaceful coexistence and shared prosperity,’” and “The ultimate goal is to establish a ‘peace that does not require fighting.’” (대북 정책에 대해선 “우리 정부는 ‘평화 공존과 공동 성장’의 시대를 열겠다는 분명하고 단호한 비전을 갖고 있다”며 “궁극적인 목표는 ‘싸울 필요가 없는 평화’를 구축하는 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding South Korea-Italy relations, President Lee remarked, “South Korea and Italy are optimal partners to create new opportunities together in future industries,” and “I hope this state visit serves as an opportunity to elevate the strategic partnership between the two countries to the next level and lay the foundation for common prosperity for future generations.” (이 대통령은 한-이탈리아 관계에 대해서는 “한국과 이탈리아는 미래 산업 분야에서 새로운 기회를 함께 만들어 갈 최적의 파트너”라며 “이번 국빈 방문이 양국의 전략적 동반자 관계를 한 단계 더 격상시키고 미래 세대를 위한 공동 번영의 토대를 다지는 계기가 되길 바란다”고 했다.)

Referring to the Middle East war and the Russia-Ukraine war, President Lee said, “In an era of complex crises, strategic dialogue between South Korea and Europe, which share the values of free trade and multilateralism, is more important than ever.” (이 대통령은 중동 전쟁과 러시아-우크라이나 전쟁 등을 언급하며 “복합 위기의 시대에, 자유무역과 다자주의라는 가치를 공유하는 한국과 유럽 간 전략적 대화는 그 어느 때보다 중요하다”고 했다.)

On the emergency martial law incident that occurred in December 2024, President Lee said, “At that time, the president made a wrong decision by declaring illegal emergency martial law, plunging the Republic of Korea into a crisis,” and “Fortunately, the martial law was neutralized thanks to citizens who stood together to defend democracy.” He added, “South Korea has not revised its constitution once in 39 years since the 1987 constitutional amendment,” and “That incident made us realize there was a lack of proper checks to limit arbitrary actions by presidential authority.” (이 대통령은 지난 2024년 12월 발생한 비상계엄 사태에 대해선 “당시 대통령이 불법적인 비상계엄을 선포하는 잘못된 결정으로 대한민국을 위기 상황에 몰아넣었다”며 “다행히도 민주주의를 지키기 위해 함께 일어선 시민들 덕분에 계엄령은 무력화됐다”고 했다. 이어 “한국은 1987년 헌법 개정 이후 39년 동안 단 한 차례도 헌법 개정이 이뤄지지 않았다”며 “그 사건은 대통령 권한의 자의적 행위를 제한할 수 있는 적절한 통제 장치가 부족했다는 점을 우리에게 깨닫게 해줬다”고 했다.)

item.title: Participants in Previous Government Rallies Lose Lawsuit Against State... Lee "Regrettable but Unavoidable" (전 정부 집회 참가자들, 국가 상대 소송 패소... 李 “안타깝지만 어쩔 수 없어”)
item.description:
Participants in Previous Government Rallies Lose Lawsuit Against State... Lee "Regrettable but Unavoidable" (전 정부 집회 참가자들, 국가 상대 소송 패소... 李 “안타깝지만 어쩔 수 없어”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 11th regarding the government's claim for litigation costs against workers who filed a damages lawsuit against the state after protesting the forceful dispersal of rallies during the Yoon Seok-yeol administration and subsequently lost, "It's regrettable, but that's what the current law dictates." (이재명 대통령은 11일 윤석열 정부 당시 집회 강제해산에 반발해 국가를 상대로 손해배상 소송을 제기했다가 패소한 노동자들에게 정부가 소송비용을 청구한 것과 관련해 “안타깝지만 현재 법이 그렇다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee made this remark on the 11th through his X (formerly Twitter) account, saying, "The court ruled in favor of the defendant, the state, concluding that it was not an unlawful exercise of public authority, and ordered the losing plaintiffs—the workers—to bear the litigation costs." (이 대통령은 11일 자신의 X(옛 트위터)를 통해 “법원이 원고인 노동자 패소로, 즉 불법적 공권력 행사가 아닌 것으로 판결하면서 소송비용을 패소한 노동자가 부담하도록 명령했다”며 이같이 말했다.)

According to an article shared by President Lee, in 2023, the 'Stop Irregular Workers Now Joint Struggle' and other groups held a rally in central Seoul opposing the Yoon Seok-yeol government's labor policies. The rally was deemed illegal and forcibly dispersed by police. Participants filed a state compensation lawsuit, claiming their freedom of assembly and protest was violated, but the case was finalized as a loss last year. Consequently, the Ministry of Justice demanded approximately 33.78 million won in litigation costs from 123 individuals. (이 대통령이 공유한 기사에 따르면, 지난 2023년 ‘비정규직 이제그만 공동투쟁’ 등은 서울 도심에서 윤석열 정부의 노동정책에 반대하는 집회를 열었다가 불법 집회로 판단돼 경찰에 의해 강제 해산됐다. 참가자들은 자신들이 집회·시위의 자유를 침해당했다며 국가배상 소송을 제기했으나, 지난해 최종 패소로 확정됐다. 이에 따라 법무부는 약 3378만원 규모의 소송 비용을 이들 123명에게 청구했다.)

President Lee stated, "Under current law, if we fail to claim the litigation costs as per the court's ruling and instead forgo them, we could be penalized for breach of trust or dereliction of duty, so there's no alternative." He added, "We are striving to ensure that the exercise of public authority is lawful and cautious, but since this case has already concluded in court and the judgment is final, the government can do nothing unless it is overturned through a retrial." He further lamented, "This abnormality has progressed too far to be corrected, and there is simply no way to fix it. It is truly regrettable." (이 대통령은 “현행법상 판결대로 소송비용을 청구하지 않고 포기하면 배임죄, 직무유기죄로 처벌하게 돼 있기 때문에 어쩔 수가 없다”며 “공권력 행사를 적법하고 신중하게 하도록 노력하고 있지만 이 사건은 이미 소송이 끝나고 판결이 확정됐기 때문에 재심으로 취소되지 않는 한 정부로서도 할 수 있는 일이 없다”고 했다. 그러면서 “이 비정상은 너무 많이 진행돼 바로잡을래야 바로잡을 길이 없다”며 “참으로 안타깝기만 하다”고 했다.)

item.title: Government holds 'Meeting of Ministers on Violation of National Suffrage' chaired by Prime Minister Kim in the evening (정부, 저녁 金총리 주재 ‘국민 참정권 침해 관계 장관 회의’)
item.description:
Government holds 'Meeting of Ministers on Violation of National Suffrage' chaired by Prime Minister Kim in the evening (정부, 저녁 金총리 주재 ‘국민 참정권 침해 관계 장관 회의’)

The government will hold a meeting on the 11th to discuss comprehensive government measures regarding the shortage of ballot papers that occurred during the June 3 local elections. (정부가 11일 6·3 지방선거에서 일어난 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 범정부 대책을 논의하는 회의를 연다.)

The Office of the Prime Minister announced that the 'Meeting of Ministers on Violation of National Suffrage' will be held at 8:30 PM at the Government Complex Sejong, chaired by Prime Minister Kim Min-seok. (국무총리실은 이날 오후 8시 30분 정부세종청사에서 김민석 총리 주재로 ‘국민 참정권 침해 관련 관계 장관 회의’를 연다고 밝혔다.)

The meeting will be attended by officials from election-related government agencies, including the presidential office, the Office for Government Policy Coordination, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the Broadcasting and Media Communications Commission, the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, and the National Police Agency. (회의에는 청와대와 국무조정실, 행정안전부, 법무부, 교육부, 문화체육관광부, 방송미디어통신위원회, 대검찰청, 경찰청 등 선거 관련 정부 기관 관계자들이 참석한다.)

In this meeting, the government plans to comprehensively review and discuss the issue of violation of national suffrage, including the ballot paper shortage, as well as the government's response to the rallies taking place at the Olympic Park in Songpa-gu, Seoul, and elsewhere. (정부는 이 회의에서 투표용지 부족 사태를 비롯한 국민 참정권 침해 문제와 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 등에서 벌어지고 있는 집회에 대한 정부 대응을 종합적으로 점검하고 논의할 예정이다.)

Prime Minister Kim stated on X (formerly Twitter) the previous day: "I have instructed all government ministries to describe the ballot paper shortage that occurred in the local elections as a 'violation of national suffrage' in light of the constitutional spirit." (김 총리는 전날 X(엑스·옛 트위터)에서 “이번 지방선거에서 발생한 투표용지 부족 사태를 헌법 정신에 비추어 ‘국민 참정권 침해’로 표현하도록 정부 각 부처에 지시했다”고 밝혔다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Separation of Defense and JCS Intelligence Chiefs Complete... Army Major General Yang Ye-seok Appointed New JCS Intelligence Chief ([단독] 국방·합참 정보본부장 분리 완료…새 합참 정보본부장에 양예석 소장)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Separation of Defense and JCS Intelligence Chiefs Complete... Army Major General Yang Ye-seok Appointed New JCS Intelligence Chief ([단독] 국방·합참 정보본부장 분리 완료…새 합참 정보본부장에 양예석 소장)

The military has completed its "separation of the dual role of Defense Intelligence Chief and Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) Intelligence Chief" as part of an efficiency drive for intelligence-related departments, it was reported on the 11th. Army Major General Yang Ye-seok will assume the post of new JCS Intelligence Chief on the 12th. (군이 정보 관련 부서 효율화 차원에서 진행한 ‘국방정보본부장의 합참정보본부장 겸직 해제’를 지난 4월 완료한 것으로 11일 알려졌다. 새로운 합참정보본부장으로 양예석 육군 소장이 12일 부임할 예정이다.)

According to the office of Rep. Kang Dae-sik of the People Power Party, a member of the National Assembly’s National Defense Committee, and military sources, Major General Yang, currently serving as the Army’s Deputy Director of Intelligence, is set to take up the position of JCS Intelligence Chief on the 12th. (이날 국회 국방위원회 소속 국민의힘 강대식 의원실과 군 소식통 등에 따르면, 현재 육군본부 정보차장을 맡고 있는 양 소장은 12일 자로 합참 정보본부장에 부임할 계획이다.)

This follows the enforcement of amendments to the Defense Intelligence Headquarters Ordinance in early April, which lifted the requirement for the Defense Intelligence Chief to concurrently serve as the JCS Intelligence Chief. (이는 국방부 소속 국방정보본부장의 합참 정보본부장 겸직을 해제하는 내용의 국방정보본부령 개정안이 지난 4월 초부터 시행된 데 따른 것이다.)

Previously, the Defense Intelligence Chief, a lieutenant general rank, also held the role of JCS Intelligence Chief. The decision to separate these roles came in response to criticism that the concentration of excessive duties on a single individual—the Defense Intelligence Chief—led to inefficiencies in organizational operations. The current Defense Intelligence Chief is Air Force Lieutenant General Kim Jun-ho. (원래 중장 계급의 국방정보본부장은 합참정보본부장을 겸해 왔다. 이번 겸직 해제 작업은 그간 국방정보본부장 한 사람에게 과도한 업무가 몰려, 조직 운영이 비효율적이라는 지적 등에 따른 것이다. 현 국방정보본부장은 김준호 공군 중장이다.)

The Defense Intelligence Chief commands subordinate units such as the Intelligence Command (responsible for overseas and North Korean military intelligence collection) and the 777th Command (involved in North Korean signals interception), but also oversaw the JCS Intelligence Department (handling early warning on North Korea), which was deemed excessive. Some critics also pointed to an "overconcentration of authority." (국방정보본부장은 예하에 있는 정보사령부(해외·대북 군사 정보 수집 등), 777사령부(대북 감청 등)를 지휘하는데, 합참정보본부(대북 조기 경보 등)까지 맡는 것이 과도하다는 것이다. 일각에선 ‘권한이 비대하다’는 비판도 있었다.)

With this separation of roles, the Defense Intelligence Headquarters will now focus solely on intelligence planning, strategy, and overseas military intelligence collection. In contrast, the JCS Intelligence Department will handle tasks such as North Korean military intelligence gathering and early warning systems regarding North Korea. (이번 본부장 직위 분리에 따라, 앞으로 국방정보본부는 정보 기획과 전략, 해외 군사 정보 수집 등 업무를 전담한다. 반면 합참정보본부는 북한 군사 정보 수집과 대북 조기 경보 등 임무를 수행하게 된다.)

Meanwhile, Major General Yang, upon assuming his new role as JCS Intelligence Chief, is expected to concurrently serve as the head of the department’s intelligence division. (한편 새 합참정보본부장으로 부임하는 양 소장은 본부 내 정보부장 직위도 겸할 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: Government: "Received notification of Fukushima contaminated water discharge suspension due to alarm… Cause under investigation" (정부 “후쿠시마 오염수 방류 경보 발생으로 중단 통보받아… 원인 조사 중”)
item.description:
Government: "Received notification of Fukushima contaminated water discharge suspension due to alarm… Cause under investigation" (정부 “후쿠시마 오염수 방류 경보 발생으로 중단 통보받아… 원인 조사 중”)

The South Korean government stated on the 11th that Japan's Tokyo Electric Power Company (TEPCO) halted the discharge of radioactive contaminated water from the Fukushima nuclear power plant after an alarm sounded during the process. The government reported receiving a notification that there were no abnormalities in the equipment, and the cause of the alarm is still being confirmed. (일본 도쿄전력이 후쿠시마 원자력발전소 방사능 오염 처리수를 방류하던 도중 경보가 울려 방류를 중단했다고 한국 정부가 11일 밝혔다. 정부는 설비에는 이상이 없고, 경보가 울린 원인은 확인 중이라는 통보를 받았다고 전했다.)

Kim Young-soo, First Deputy Director of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, announced in a written briefing on the 11th, "The government was immediately informed yesterday (the 10th) through diplomatic and regulatory channels between South Korea and Japan that during the 20th discharge of contaminated water by TEPCO, an alarm occurred in the transfer process, leading to an automatic stop of the contaminated water discharge around 4:17 PM on the 10th." (김영수 국무조정실 국무1차장은 11일 서면 브리핑을 통해 “정부는 어제(10일) 한·일 외교·규제 채널을 통해 도쿄전력의 오염수 20차 방류 과정에서 이송 공정 경보 발생으로 10일 오후 4시 17분경 오염수 방류가 자동 정지된 상황을 즉시 공유받았다”고 밝혔다.)

TEPCO has been storing radioactive contaminated water generated from the decommissioning process following the 2011 Fukushima Daiichi nuclear disaster in tanks, and after treating it through the Advanced Liquid Processing System (ALPS) to remove radioactive substances, it has been collecting a certain amount and then releasing it into the sea. The first discharge began on August 24, 2023, and the 20th discharge has been ongoing since the 1st of this month. (도쿄전력은 2011년 후쿠시마 제1원전에서 일어난 사고를 처리하는 과정에서 생긴 방사능 오염수를 수조에 보관해 왔고, ‘다핵종 제거 설비(ALPS)’를 통해 방사능 물질을 걸러내는 처리를 거친 물을 일정량씩 모아뒀다가 바다에 흘려보내고 있다. 첫 방류는 2023년 8월 24일 시작했고, 지난 1일부터 20차 방류를 진행하고 있었다.)

Deputy Director Kim explained, "This automatic stop was a measure taken in accordance with a designed plan to automatically shut off the discharge when a situation occurs during the contaminated water release." (김 차장은 “이번 자동 정지는 오염수 방류 중 상황 발생 시 방류가 자동으로 차단되도록 설계된 계획에 따른 조치”라고 설명했다.)

He further stated, "TEPCO has confirmed after checking the site conditions that there are currently no abnormalities in the (contaminated water) transfer equipment, and they reported that the cause of the alarm is under investigation." (이어 “도쿄전력은 현장 상황을 점검한 결과 현재 (오염 처리수) 이송 설비에 이상이 없음을 확인했고, 경보 발생 원인에 대해서는 조사 중이라고 밝혔다”고 전했다.)

Deputy Director Kim added, "The government is continuously monitoring the situation at the Fukushima nuclear plant," and "If additional information, such as the cause of the alarm, is identified, we will provide further explanations later." (김 차장은 “정부는 후쿠시마 원전 현지 상황을 지속적으로 모니터링하고 있다”며 “경보 발생 원인 등 추가적인 정보가 파악되는 경우, 추후 설명드리겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kang Chang-il, Senior Advisor of Peaceful Unification Advisory Council, Mourns Passing of Japan’s Kono... “Hope the Will of the Deceased, Who Worked to Promote Korea-Japan Friendship, Will Be Carried On” (강창일 평통수석, 日고노 별세 애도…“한일 우호증진에 힘쓴 고인 뜻 계승되기를”)
item.description:
Kang Chang-il, Senior Advisor of Peaceful Unification Advisory Council, Mourns Passing of Japan’s Kono... “Hope the Will of the Deceased, Who Worked to Promote Korea-Japan Friendship, Will Be Carried On” (강창일 평통수석, 日고노 별세 애도…“한일 우호증진에 힘쓴 고인 뜻 계승되기를” )

Kang Chang-il, senior vice chair of the Democratic Peaceful Unification Advisory Council (DPUAC) and former ambassador to Japan, expressed his condolences on the 11th regarding the passing of Yohei Kono, former Chief Cabinet Secretary and Speaker of the House of Representatives of Japan. (주일 대사를 지낸 강창일 민주평화통일자문회의(민주평통) 수석부의장은 11일 고노 요헤이 전 일본 관방장관·중의원 의장의 별세에 애도를 표했다.)

In a condolence message distributed to the media that day, Senior Vice Chair Kang said, “I still vividly remember inviting the deceased to the official residence when I was ambassador to Japan, where we shared many deep conversations.” He added, “He was a person who, throughout his life, not only worked to promote friendship between Korea and Japan but also took a cautious stance on revising Japan’s peace constitution, which explicitly renounces war, and placed great importance on peace in Northeast Asia.” (강 수석부의장은 이날 언론에 배포한 조의메시지를 통해 “제가 주일대사였던 시절 관저로 고인을 초청해 속 깊은 대화까지도 많이 나누었던 기억이 아직도 생생하다”며 “고인은 평생 한일 양국 간의 우호증진은 물론 전쟁 포기가 명시된 일본 평화헌법의 개정에 신중한 입장을 취했던, 동북아 지역의 평화를 중요시했던 분이었다”고 했다.)

Senior Vice Chair Kang stated about the deceased, “As Chief Cabinet Secretary of the Miyazawa Cabinet in 1993, he issued the ‘Kono Statement,’ which acknowledged the forced nature of the mobilization of comfort women by the Japanese military and its involvement, and offered an apology. This was a courageous decision for improving bilateral relations and establishing a future-oriented Korea-Japan relationship.” He further remarked, “I believe his courage led to the 1995 ‘Murayama Statement,’ which included the Japanese government’s first apology for colonial rule, and became a model that runs through Korea-Japan history.” (강 수석부의장은 고인에 대해 “1993년 미야자와 내각의 관방장관으로서 일본군 위안부 동원의 강제성과 군의 관여를 인정하고 사죄하는 ‘고노담화’를 발표한 바 있다”며 “이는 양국관계 개선과 미래지향적인 한일관계 정립을 위한 용기 있는 결단이었다”고 했다. 그러면서 “그의 용기는 일본 정부의 첫 식민지 지배 사과를 담은 1995년 ‘무라야마 담화’로 이어지면서 한일 역사를 꿰뚫는 하나의 전범이 되었다고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Senior Vice Chair Kang expressed, “As stated in the Kono Statement, I earnestly hope that the upright intention, ‘We do not wish to avoid the truth of this history, but rather face it squarely as a lesson of history,’ will be carried on as the will of the Japanese government over time, and that the friendly relations between Korea and Japan will continue to develop further.” (강 수석부의장은 “고노 담화에 명시된 것처럼 ‘우리는 이런 역사의 진실을 회피하는 일이 없이 오히려 이를 역사의 교훈으로 직시해 가고 싶다’는 올곧은 뜻이 세월이 지나도 일본 정부의 뜻으로 계승되고, 한일 양국의 친선 우호 관계가 더더욱 발전돼 가기를 바라마지 않는다”고 했다.)

Senior Vice Chair Kang recalled, “In the 1970s, the deceased sought to visit President Kim Dae-jung, who was under house arrest. At that time, President Kim sent a considerate message telling him, ‘Please don’t come. Meeting me could cause trouble for you, Dietmember Kono,’ and I remember being deeply moved when he shared this anecdote at the ambassador’s residence.” He added about the deceased, “He was actively involved in efforts to rescue Kim Dae-jung not only during the 1973 abduction incident but also after a death sentence was imposed on charges of insurrection in 1980. And because he was dispatched as a special envoy of the Japanese government for President Kim Dae-jung’s funeral in 2009, there was mutual respect and friendship between the two.” <<>> (강 수석부의장은 “1970년대 가택연금 중이었던 김대중 대통령을 고인께서 찾아뵙고자 했는데 당시 김 대통령께서 자신에게 ‘오지 말아 달라. 나를 만나면 고노 의원 당신이 곤란해질 수 있다’는 배려의 메시지를 보내와 당시 정말 감동했다는 일화를 대사관저에서 들려주었던 기억도 있다”고 회고했다. 강 수석부의장은 고인에 대해 “1973년 김대중 납치 사건은 물론 1980년 내란죄로 사형 판결이 내려진 이후에도 김대중 구출 운동에 적극 나섰던 분이었고 2009년 서거한 김대중 대통령의 장례식 때에는 일본 정부의 특사로 파견된 만큼 두 분 사이에는 서로에 대한 존경과 우정을 갖고 있었다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae Defends 'One Person, One Vote' System: "It is Democracy Itself" (정청래, 1인 1표제 비판에 “1인 1표제는 민주주의 그 자체”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae Defends 'One Person, One Vote' System: "It is Democracy Itself" (정청래, 1인 1표제 비판에 “1인 1표제는 민주주의 그 자체”)

Amid renewed internal criticism of the 'one person, one vote' system for delegates and paid party members, which was introduced for the election of the party leader and supreme council members, Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae stated on the 11th, "The one person, one vote system is democracy itself," signaling his intention to maintain it. (더불어민주당 정청래 대표가 당대표·최고위원 선거 등에 도입한 ‘대의원·권리당원 1인 1표제’를 두고 당내에서 다시 비판이 나오는 가운데, 정 대표가 11일 “1인 1표제는 민주주의 그 자체”라며 이를 고수하겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다.)

That afternoon, Jung posted on Facebook the headline of an article titled, "Jung Cheong-rae's One Person, One Vote System Becomes a Fuse for the Opposition Party's National Convention." The article reported on the system introduced by Jung emerging as a point of contention at the Democratic Party's national convention, scheduled for August 17. (정 대표는 이날 오후 페이스북에 ‘정청래표 1인 1표제, 與 전대 뇌관 되나’라는 한 기사의 제목을 올렸다. 이 기사는 정 대표가 도입한 1인 1표제가 오는 8월 17일 열릴 민주당 전당대회의 쟁점으로 부상하고 있다는 내용이다.)

In response, Jung wrote, "The one person, one vote system is democracy itself. Democracy must be preserved." (이에 대해 정 대표는 “1인 1표제는 민주주의 그 자체”라며 “민주주의는 지켜져야 한다”고 썼다.)

The one person, one vote system was a key pledge by Jung during last year's party leadership election, with its core being the elimination of differences in the voting weight between delegates and paid party members in internal Democratic Party elections. Although Jung championed it under the banner of member democracy, the pro-Lee Jae-myung faction opposed it, arguing that "Jung is changing the rules to his advantage in order to secure a second term as party leader." The proposed amendment to the party constitution and rules to introduce the one person, one vote system for the party leader and supreme council elections faced a rejection before passing through the party's central committee in February. The day prior, a rule amendment introducing the same system for the election of the national committee chair and city/provincial party chairs passed the party affairs committee and was sent to the central committee. (1인 1표제는 정 대표가 지난해 당대표 선거에서 핵심 공약으로 내걸었던 것으로, 민주당 내부 선거에서 대의원과 권리당원의 표 반영 비율 차이를 없애는 것이 핵심이다. 정 대표는 당원 민주주의를 명분으로 내걸었으나, 친명계는 “정 대표가 당대표를 연임하기 위해서 유리하게 제도를 바꾸는 것”이라며 반발했다. 당대표·최고위원 선거에 1인 1표제를 도입하는 당헌·당규 개정안은 한 차례 부결되는 진통 끝에 지난 2월 당 중앙위원회를 통과했다. 전날에는 전국위원장과 시·도당위원장 선출에도 1인 1표제를 도입하는 당규 개정안이 당무위원회를 통과해 중앙위로 보내졌다.)

However, amidst assessments that the Democratic Party effectively suffered defeat in the June 3 local elections, criticism or calls for at least supplementary measures regarding the one person, one vote system have begun emerging within the party. Lawmaker Jeon Hyun-hee stated at a National Assembly forum on the 9th, "As the Democratic Party introduced the one person, one vote system, it has come to appear out of touch with public sentiment." The following day, she added on Facebook, "We must seek institutional supplements to narrow the gap between party sentiment and public sentiment revealed through this local election." Lawmaker Lee Geon-tae also posted on Facebook the same day, stating, "Member sovereignty does not merely mean the right to vote with one person, one vote. Member sovereignty that is applied selectively and emphasized only when needed is ultimately just 'selective member sovereignty.'" (그러나 6·3 지방선거에서 민주당이 사실상 패배했다는 평가가 나오는 가운데, 당내에서 1인 1표제에 대한 비판 또는 최소한 보완해야 한다는 지적이 나오기 시작했다. 전현희 의원은 지난 9일 국회 토론회에서 “민주당이 1인 1표제를 도입하면서 한편으로 민심과 괴리되는 모습을 띠고 있다”고 했다. 이튿날에는 페이스북에서 “이번 지방선거를 통해 드러난 당심과 민심 사이의 간극을 줄여나갈 제도적 보완을 모색해야 한다”고 했다. 이건태 의원도 같은 날 페이스북에서 “당원 주권은 단순히 1인 1표 투표할 권리만 의미하는 것이 아니다”라며 “상황에 따라 적용하고 필요할 때만 강조하는 당원 주권은 결국 ‘선택적 당원 주권’에 불과하다”고 했다.)

In response, pro-Jung supreme council member Lee Seong-yoon said at the party's supreme council meeting on the 10th, "The hearts of party members, or party sentiment, is also part of public sentiment. To become a more democratic Democratic Party, we must move forward as a one person, one vote Democratic Party." Conversely, lawmaker Kim Nam-hee stated on the 11th, "Eliminating delegate authority and allowing all members to exercise one person, one vote may seem very democratic at first glance, but we also need to consider various issues." (이에 대해 친청계 이성윤 최고위원은 지난 10일 당 최고위원회의에서 “당원들의 마음, 당심도 민심의 일부”라며 “더 민주적인 민주당이 되기 위해 1인 1표 민주당으로 나아가야 한다”고 했다. 반면 김남희 의원은 11일 “대의원 권한을 없애고 모든 당원이 1인 1표를 행사하는 방안은 얼핏 보기에는 매우 민주적이지만, 여러 문제점도 고민해볼 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon Tells Jang Dong-hyuk to "Step Down" ... Extends Congratulations to New Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik (한동훈, 장동혁에 “물러나야”... 신임 원내대표 정점식엔 축하 난)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon Tells Jang Dong-hyuk to "Step Down" ... Extends Congratulations to New Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik (한동훈, 장동혁에 “물러나야”... 신임 원내대표 정점식엔 축하 난 )

Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who won the by-election for the Busan North Gap district, sent a congratulatory wreath to the People Power Party's new floor leader, Jeong Jeom-sik, on the 11th, expressing his desire to "stand with everyone who agrees on the need to rebuild conservatism and restore the balance of the Republic of Korea." At the same time, he directed remarks at party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, urging him essentially to resign by saying, "One must know when to step down." (부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거에 당선된 무소속 한동훈 의원이 11일 국민의힘 정점식 신임 원내대표에게 축하 난을 보내고 “보수를 재건하고 대한민국 균형추를 바로잡자는 생각에 공감하는 모든 분과 함께 가고 싶다”는 뜻을 밝혔다. 그러면서 장동혁 대표를 향해서는 “물러날 때를 알아야 한다”며 사실상 사퇴를 촉구했다.)

Meeting with reporters at the National Assembly that day, Han stated, "Rebuilding conservatism is about the future, not about pinpointing who was wrong in the past," adding, "That's why I sent a congratulatory wreath to Floor Leader Jeong." (한 의원은 이날 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “보수 재건은 미래를 향한 것이지, 과거에 누가 잘못했다는 것을 가려내자는 것은 아니다”라며 “그런 차원에서 정 원내대표께 축하 난을 보냈다”고 했다.)

Han called for the resignation of People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk. He said, "Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who acts as an obstacle to the rebuilding of conservatism, must know when to step down," adding, "This isn't just my opinion—isn't it the thought of all journalists and citizens? In the end, conservatism must be rebuilt." (한 의원은 장동혁 국민의힘 대표에게는 사퇴를 촉구했다. 그는 “보수 재건의 걸림돌로 작용하는 장동혁 대표는 물러날 때를 알아야 한다”며 “제 생각이 아니라 모든 언론인의 생각, 시민들의 생각이 아니겠나. 결국 보수는 재건돼야 한다”고 했다.)

Regarding Jang's statement that the party should focus on the ballot shortage crisis, Han commented, "Without him, the party could be more focused. Because he's there, this issue isn't being properly raised," and added, "By clinging to election fraud conspiracy theories for his own survival, he cannot properly channel the anger of the youth and the people." (그는 장 대표가 투표용지 부족 사태에 당력을 집중해야 한다고 밝히고 있는 것과 관련해서는 “그분이 없으면 더 집중될 수 있다. 그분이 있으니까 제대로 이 문제를 제기하지 못한다”며 “자기 연명을 위해서 부정선거 음모론까지 올라타는 것으로 청년과 국민의 분노를 제대로 담을 수는 없다”고 했다.)

The newly elected floor leader of the People Power Party, Jeong Jeom-sik, who was chosen the previous day, addressed Jang Dong-hyuk's status in a media interview, stating, "Ultimately, it's a matter of how we evaluate and assign responsibility for the local elections," and "I will discuss it openly and candidly with lawmakers within the party and address it through collective wisdom." (전날 선출된 정점식 국민의힘 신임 원내대표는 언론 인터뷰에서 장동혁 대표의 거취 문제와 관련해 “결국 지방선거에 대한 평가와 그 책임을 어떻게 지워야 할 것인가 하는 문제”라며 “의원들과 원내에서 허심탄회하게 상의해 집단지성으로 대처해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Government: "Japan's Discharge of Contaminated Water, Halted by Alarm, Resumes After One Day" (정부 “경보 발령으로 중단됐던 日 오염수 방류 하루 만에 재개”)
item.description:
Government: "Japan's Discharge of Contaminated Water, Halted by Alarm, Resumes After One Day" (정부 “경보 발령으로 중단됐던 日 오염수 방류 하루 만에 재개”)

The South Korean government announced that Tokyo Electric Power Company (TEPCO) halted the discharge of treated radioactive water from the Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant on the afternoon of the 10th due to an alarm, and resumed it on the afternoon of the 11th. (일본 도쿄전력이 지난 10일 오후 후쿠시마 원자력발전소 방사능 오염 처리수를 방류하던 도중 경보가 울려 방류를 중단했다가 11일 오후 재개했다고 한국 정부가 밝혔다.)

Kim Young-soo, First Deputy Director of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, stated in a written briefing around 2:48 PM that day, "The government was immediately informed through South Korea-Japan diplomatic and regulatory channels yesterday (the 10th) that during the 20th discharge of contaminated water by TEPCO, an alarm occurred in the transfer process, leading to an automatic stop of the discharge at approximately 4:17 PM on the 10th." Deputy Director Kim added, "TEPCO stated that it is investigating the cause of the alarm." (김영수 국무조정실 국무1차장은 이날 오후 2시 48분쯤 서면 브리핑을 통해 “정부는 어제(10일) 한·일 외교·규제 채널을 통해 도쿄전력의 오염수 20차 방류 과정에서 이송 공정 경보 발생으로 10일 오후 4시 17분경 오염수 방류가 자동 정지된 상황을 즉시 공유받았다”고 밝혔다. 김 차장은 “도쿄전력은 경보 발생 원인에 대해서는 조사 중이라고 밝혔다”고 전했다.)

TEPCO has been storing radioactive contaminated water generated during the cleanup of the 2011 Fukushima Daiichi accident in tanks and, after treating it through the Advanced Liquid Processing System (ALPS) to remove radioactive substances, has been releasing designated amounts into the sea. The first discharge began on August 24, 2023, and the 20th discharge has been underway since the 1st of this month. (도쿄전력은 2011년 후쿠시마 제1원전에서 일어난 사고를 처리하는 과정에서 생긴 방사능 오염수를 수조에 보관해 왔고, ‘다핵종 제거 설비(ALPS)’를 통해 방사능 물질을 걸러내는 처리를 거친 물을 일정량씩 모아뒀다가 바다에 흘려보내고 있다. 첫 방류는 2023년 8월 24일 시작했고, 지난 1일부터 20차 방류를 진행하고 있었다.)

Deputy Director Kim then provided an additional briefing at 6:53 PM that day, stating, "TEPCO announced that after replacing the valve between the contaminated water tank and the transfer pump that triggered the alarm, it resumed the discharge at 4:10 PM." (김 차장은 이어 이날 오후 6시 53분에 추가 브리핑을 통해 “도쿄전력이 경보를 발생시킨 오염수 탱크와 이송 펌프 사이의 밸브를 교체한 후 오후 4시 10분 방류를 재개했다고 밝혔다”고 전했다.)

Deputy Director Kim said, "The government will continue to actively respond by consistently monitoring the situation at the Fukushima nuclear plant." (김 차장은 “정부는 앞으로도 후쿠시마 원전 상황을 지속적으로 모니터링하는 등 적극 대응해 나가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Last Year, 313 National Civil Servants Dismissed or Removed… 2,122 Received Disciplinary Actions (지난해 국가공무원 313명 파면·해임… 2122명 징계 받아)
item.description:
Last Year, 313 National Civil Servants Dismissed or Removed… 2,122 Received Disciplinary Actions (지난해 국가공무원 313명 파면·해임… 2122명 징계 받아)

Last year, 2,122 out of the national civil servants under the executive branch received disciplinary measures such as dismissal, removal, or suspension. (지난해 행정부 소속 국가공무원 가운데 2122명이 파면·해임·정직 등 징계를 받은 것으로 나타났다.)

According to the ‘2025 Personnel Statistics of Executive Branch National Civil Servants’ released by the Ministry of Personnel Management on the 11th, as of the end of last year, 2,122 out of 764,336 national civil servants under the executive branch (0.3%) faced disciplinary actions. This includes civil servants who, dissatisfied with the disciplinary measures, filed appeals for review or initiated administrative litigation, where the disciplinary action has not been finalized. (인사혁신처가 11일 공개한 ‘2025년 행정부 국가공무원 인사 통계’에 따르면, 지난해 말 기준 행정부 소속 국가공무원 76만4336명 가운데 2122명(0.3%)이 징계를 받았다. 여기에는 징계 처분에 불복해 소청 심사를 청구하거나 행정소송에 나서, 징계가 최종 확정되지 않은 공무원도 포함된다.)

106 were dismissed, 207 were removed, totaling 313 who received orders to leave public service. The most common reason was violation of the duty to maintain dignity, with 187 cases, followed by violation of the duty of diligence with 59, violation of the duty of integrity with 22, and violation of the prohibition on workplace absence with 15. Nine cases involved violation of the duty of confidentiality, and two cases involved violation of the prohibition on profit-seeking or holding multiple positions. There was also one case each of dismissal or removal for violation of service duties and prohibition on political activities. (106명이 파면, 207명이 해임 등 313명이 공직을 떠나는 처분을 받았다. 그 사유로는 품위 유지 의무 위반이 187명으로 가장 많았고, 성실 의무 위반이 59명, 청렴 의무 위반이 22명, 직장 이탈 금지 위반이 15명이었다. 9명은 비밀 엄수 의무 위반, 2명은 영리·겸직 금지 위반이 사유였다. 복무 위반이나 정치 운동 금지 위반으로 파면·해임된 사람도 1명씩 있었다.)

156 were demoted, 507 were suspended, totaling 663 who faced severe disciplinary actions. Violation of the duty to maintain dignity was the most common, with 495 cases, followed by violation of the duty of diligence with 125, violation of the duty of integrity with 14, and violation of the prohibition on workplace absence with 11. (156명이 강등, 507명이 정직 등 663명이 중징계를 받았다. 품위 유지 의무 위반이 495명으로 가장 많았고, 성실 의무 위반이 125명, 청렴 의무 위반이 14명, 직장 이탈 금지 위반이 11명이었다.)

1,146 civil servants received minor disciplinary actions: 496 faced salary reduction and 650 received reprimands. Violation of the duty to maintain dignity was the most common with 587 cases, followed by violation of the duty of diligence with 431. There were 38 cases of violation of the duty of integrity, 23 cases of violation of the prohibition on workplace absence, and 12 cases of violation of the duty of confidentiality. (경징계를 받은 공무원은 1146명으로, 496명이 감봉, 650명이 견책 처분을 받았다. 품위 유지 의무 위반이 587명으로 가장 많았고, 성실 의무 위반이 431명으로 그다음이었다. 청렴 의무 위반이 38명, 직장 이탈 금지 위반이 23명, 비밀 엄수 의무 위반이 12명이었다.)

Last year, 26,952 civil servants retired. Among them, 11,652 retired due to reaching retirement age, and 712 retired upon expiration of their terms. 361 died while in service. 313 were forced to retire due to dismissal or removal. (지난해 퇴직한 공무원은 2만6952명이었다. 이 가운데 1만1652명은 정년이 돼, 712명은 임기가 만료돼 퇴직했다. 361명은 재직 중 사망했다. 313명은 파면·해임으로 강제 퇴직됐다.)

13,651 voluntarily resigned: 7,808 left education civil servant positions such as teachers, and 6,069 left general civil servant roles in narrow sense, including administrative, scientific and technological, and management and operation job groups. 1,059 retired from postal service positions. 175 left prosecutor positions, and 134 left foreign service positions. (스스로 원해서 그만둔 사람은 1만3651명으로, 7808명은 교사 등 교육공무원을 그만뒀고, 6069명은 행정·과학기술·관리운영 직군 등 좁은 의미의 일반직 공무원을 그만뒀다. 1059명은 우정직에서 퇴직했다. 검사를 그만둔 사람은 175명, 외무공무원을 그만둔 사람은 134명이었다.)

As of the end of last year, there were 764,336 national civil servants under the executive branch, including 176 political appointees (president, prime minister, deputy prime ministers, ministers, vice ministers, etc.) and 183,778 general civil servants. There were 364,106 education civil servants, 144,547 police officers, 67,071 firefighters, 2,194 foreign service officers, and 2,098 prosecutors. (지난해 말 기준 행정부 소속 국가공무원은 76만4336명으로, 대통령·국무총리·부총리·장관·차관 등 정무직이 176명, 일반직이 18만3778명이었다. 교육공무원은 36만4106명, 경찰공무원은 14만4547명, 소방공무원은 6만7071명, 외무공무원은 2194명, 검사는 2098명이었다.)

There were 390,739 local civil servants under local governments within the executive branch. Additionally, 4,923 were under the National Assembly, 19,322 under the courts, 396 under the Constitutional Court, and 3,224 under the National Election Commission. (행정부 지방자치단체 소속인 지방공무원은 39만739명이었다. 국회 소속은 4923명, 법원 소속은 1만9322명, 헌법재판소 소속은 396명, 중앙선거관리위원회 소속은 3224명이었다.)

item.title: Calls for Jeong Cheong-rae’s resignation surge... “Election, psychologically worse than a landslide defeat” (與, 정청래 사퇴론 쏟아졌다... “선거, 심리적으로 참패 이상”)
item.description:
Calls for Jeong Cheong-rae’s resignation surge... “Election, psychologically worse than a landslide defeat” (與, 정청래 사퇴론 쏟아졌다... “선거, 심리적으로 참패 이상”)

At a closed-door general meeting of lawmakers held at the National Assembly on the 11th to evaluate the results of the June 3 local elections, some members of the Democratic Party of Korea reportedly called for leader Jeong Cheong-rae to resign, raising the issue of leadership responsibility. <<> According to a compilation of reports by this newspaper, lawmaker Jang Cheol-min is known to have argued at the general meeting, “For the success and restoration of trust in the Lee Jae-myung government, Representative Jeong Cheong-rae should resign from the party leadership.” He evaluated the local election results by saying, “A predictable defeat is unacceptable” and described it as “psychologically worse than a landslide defeat.” He further added, “There was a lack of party-level awareness of the failure” and “There was no signal for a strategic shift even as we were losing the Seoul mayoral election.” <<> Lawmaker Im Mi-ae, chair of the Gyeongbuk Provincial Party Committee, also reportedly raised the issue of leadership responsibility, stating, “The party failed to properly manage internal conflicts during the national election process.” In particular, she is said to have expressed that if Representative Jeong seeks re-election, “He should resign to ensure that the party convention preparations and election management are fair and transparent.” <<> During the general meeting, criticism continued over the causes of the local election defeat and issues related to candidate nominations and primary management. <<> Lawmaker Shin Jeong-hoon, who ran in the primary for the integrated special city mayor election of South Jeolla Province and Gwangju, criticized technical errors and primary management issues that occurred during the primary process in the South Jeolla and Gwangju regions. He reportedly pointed out, “The primary management was too unfriendly and opaque,” adding, “Illegal party member recruitment was rampant, and there were many cases of candidates winning as independents after leaving the party.” <<> Lawmaker Jeong Il-young, regarding the defeat in the Incheon Yeonsu-gu district head election, is known to have criticized, “In the local committee, a candidate who was subject to rigorous screening was approved by the central party,” and “There was no primary system in place.” <<> Secretary-General Jo Seung-rae reportedly acknowledged during the general meeting that there were technical issues in the primary process for the South Jeolla and Gwangju regions. However, he is said to have urged that some claims be raised with supporting evidence. <<> Calls for Representative Jeong’s resignation have continued since the election. Democratic Party lawmaker Park Ji-won argued in a radio interview on the 10th, “The Democratic Party won arithmetically but lost politically,” and “Representative Jeong Cheong-rae and the leadership should resign en masse and declare they will not run in the next party convention.” Supreme Council member Hwang Myeong-seon also declared he would not run for re-election as a supreme council member, saying, “As one of the failed leadership, not running is the duty to party members,” adding weight to the leadership responsibility argument. <<> However, the party leadership maintains that there has been no official discussion on resignation. Assembly spokesperson Lee Ju-hee told reporters after the general meeting, “Opinions on leadership resignation came up during free speeches, but it is not an officially discussed matter,” and “It is a matter dependent on the leader’s political free will.” <<> In his opening remarks at the general meeting released today, Representative Jeong stated, “Yesterday, I said I agree with President Lee Jae-myung’s assessment and perception,” and “Under the grand proposition of the success of the Lee Jae-myung government and regaining power, our first priority is unity, second is unity, and third is unity.” <<> However, it is reported that after the meeting went into closed session, as many lawmakers directed criticism at him for over an hour, Representative Jeong left the general meeting venue without any significant concluding remarks. (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거 결과를 평가하기 위해 11일 국회에서 개최한 비공개 의원총회에서 일부 의원들이 정청래 대표의 사퇴를 요구하며 지도부 책임론을 제기한 것으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: Election Commissions in Gyeonggi and North Jeolla Late to Discover Errors in Vote Count Input (경기·전북 선관위, 개표 결과 입력 오류 뒤늦게 발견)
item.description:
Election Commissions in Gyeonggi and North Jeolla Late to Discover Errors in Vote Count Input (경기·전북 선관위, 개표 결과 입력 오류 뒤늦게 발견)

It was belatedly confirmed that errors occurred in the input of vote count results for the Gyeonggi Province Superintendent of Education election and the North Jeolla Province Superintendent of Education election due to mistakes by those in charge. The Gyeonggi Provincial Election Commission and the North Jeolla Provincial Election Commission issued public apologies on the 11th. <<> According to the National Election Commission (NEC) on the same day, the Gyeonggi Provincial Election Commission announced that at the third polling station in Geumgwang 2-dong, Jungwon-gu, Seongnam, candidate Im Tae-hee received 337 votes and candidate Ahn Min-seok received 368 votes, but the accurate vote count turned out to be 368 votes for candidate Im and 337 votes for candidate Ahn. <<> The Gyeonggi Provincial Election Commission stated, "That polling station used Type B ballots, so the candidate order was Ahn Min-seok followed by Im Tae-hee. However, the input screen displayed the default order of Im Tae-hee followed by Ahn Min-seok, leading to a mix-up in inputting the vote counts for the two candidates." <<> Additionally, at the second polling station in Chowol-eup, Gwangju, it was initially announced that candidate Im received 668 votes and candidate Ahn received 582 votes, but the accurate vote count was confirmed as 869 votes for candidate Im and 798 votes for candidate Ahn. <<> The Gyeonggi Provincial Election Commission explained, "A vote-counting official mistakenly entered the data from the ninth polling station in Chowol-eup as that of the second polling station. While the error was discovered during the counting process and the results for the ninth polling station were corrected, the previously misentered results for the second polling station were not amended, causing the vote counts from the ninth polling station to be duplicated across both the second and ninth polling stations." <<> The Gyeonggi Provincial Election Commission said that during a full verification of vote counts to confirm the elected candidate, the Seongnam City Election Commission confirmed the input error on the 10th, and the Gwangju City Election Commission on the 9th. <<> The Gyeonggi Provincial Election Commission stated, "We are fully aware that there is no excuse for failing to conduct thorough verification during the input process, despite our duty to accurately manage and announce voting results, and we take this matter very seriously. We bow our heads and offer a deep apology to all voters." <<> Furthermore, at the third polling station in Junghwasan 1-dong, Wansan-gu, Jeonju, North Jeolla, it was revealed that the vote count results were incorrectly entered as those of the first polling station. The North Jeolla Provincial Election Commission announced, "Compared to the actual vote counts, the disclosed results showed a difference of 110 total votes, 62 votes for candidate Lee Nam-ho, 43 votes for candidate Cheon Ho-seong, and 5 invalid votes." <<> The North Jeolla Provincial Election Commission said, "Taking this incident as an opportunity, we will improve the vote record creation system, revise regulations such as work manuals or guidelines to prevent input errors in vote counting, and actively propose to the National Election Commission necessary institutional improvements for the currently inadequate election management system. We bow our heads and sincerely apologize for causing concern by failing to perfectly manage the precious choices made by the people and provincial residents." (경기도교육감 선거와 전북교육감 선거에서 담당자 실수로 개표 결과가 잘못 입력됐던 사실이 뒤늦게 확인됐다. 경기도선거관리위원회와 전북선거관리위원회는 11일 대국민 사과문을 발표했다.)

item.title: President Lee Orders PM's Office Investigation: "If Forced Drinking and Death of Firefighter Are True, Maximum Accountability" (李대통령 “소방관 사망, 갑질 사실이면 최대 문책” 지시에 총리실 조사 착수)
item.description:
President Lee Orders PM's Office Investigation: "If Forced Drinking and Death of Firefighter Are True, Maximum Accountability" (李대통령 “소방관 사망, 갑질 사실이면 최대 문책” 지시에 총리실 조사 착수)

The Prime Minister's Office announced on the 11th that it would launch an investigation into suspicions that a female firefighter in her twenties from the Gwangju Fire Safety Headquarters died by suicide due to forced drinking. President Lee Jae-myung ordered the cabinet to investigate the case on the same day. (광주 소방안전본부 소속 20대 여성 소방관이 음주 강요로 극단적 선택을 했다는 의혹에 대해 11일 국무총리실이 조사에 착수한다고 밝혔다. 이재명 대통령은 이날 내각에 이 사건 조사를 지시했다.)

The Public Service Ethics Management Office under the Office for Government Policy Coordination released a press statement that afternoon, saying, "In accordance with the president's directive, we have decided to promptly launch an investigation into the suspicions surrounding the firefighter's death that have been recently reported in the media." (국무조정실 공직복무관리관실은 이날 오후 보도 자료를 배포해 “대통령 지시 사항에 따라 최근 언론에 보도된 소방관 사망 사고와 관련된 의혹에 대해 신속히 조사에 착수하기로 했다”고 밝혔다.)

The Public Service Ethics Management Office is a department tasked primarily with 'establishing discipline in the public service' and handles investigations into cases directed by the president or the prime minister. (공직복무관리관실은 ‘공직사회 기강 확립’을 주 업무로 하는 부서로, 대통령이나 국무총리가 지시한 사건에 대한 조사를 담당한다.)

The Public Service Ethics Management Office stated, "Considering the gravity of the matter, we will investigate as quickly as possible to thoroughly clarify the facts—including whether forced drinking occurred and whether the bereaved family's request for an inspectorial investigation was ignored—to ensure the president's directive is fully implemented." (공직복무관리관실은 “사안의 중대성을 고려해 대통령 지시 사항이 철저히 이행될 수 있도록 음주 강요, 유가족의 감찰 조사 요구 묵살 여부 등을 최대한 신속히 조사해 사실관계를 명명백백히 밝힐 예정”이라고 했다.)

Earlier that afternoon, President Lee, who was on a European tour, posted a link on his X account (formerly Twitter) to an article reporting that a female firefighter in her twenties from the Gwangju Fire Headquarters had died by suicide last October ahead of her wedding, leading the National Fire Agency to conduct an internal inspection. According to the article, the Gwangju Fire Headquarters stated in an official document that the deceased had difficulties in her relationship with her boyfriend as the cause of death. However, KakaoTalk conversations between the boyfriend and the deceased indicated that she struggled with workplace issues, particularly forced drinking. The Gwangju Fire Headquarters ignored the boyfriend's protests for over five months, and an inspection only began after the boyfriend, the bereaved family, and the firefighter's union visited the National Fire Agency. (앞서 이날 오후 유럽 순방 중인 이 대통령은 자신의 X(옛 트위터)에 광주소방본부 20대 여성 소방관이 지난해 10월 결혼을 앞두고 스스로 목숨을 끊어 소방청이 내부 감찰을 진행하고 있다는 내용의 기사 링크를 올렸다. 기사에 따르면, 광주소방본부는 고인이 남자친구와의 관계에서 어려움을 겪은 것이 사망 원인이라고 공문에 적었다. 그러나 남자친구와 고인이 주고받은 카카오톡 대화에 따르면 고인은 직장 내부 문제, 특히 음주 강요로 힘들어했다. 광주소방본부는 남자친구의 항의를 5개월 넘게 묵살했고, 남자친구와 유족, 소방노조가 소방청을 방문한 뒤에야 감찰이 시작됐다.)

President Lee said, "It is truly deplorable that there are still public officials with such outdated attitudes," and added, "Conduct a thorough investigation into not only the cause and circumstances of the firefighter's death, including workplace dinners and forced drinking, but also the circumstances surrounding the ignored request for an inspectorial investigation. The investigation body should be the Office for Government Policy Coordination, not the National Fire Agency, to ensure objectivity." (이 대통령은 “아직도 이런 구태 공직자들이 있다니 참으로 개탄스럽다”며 “회식, 음주 강요 등 소방관의 사망 원인과 경위는 물론 감찰 조사 요청 묵살 경위까지 철저히 조사하라. 조사 주체는 객관성을 담보할 수 있도록 소방청이 아닌 국조실로 하라”고 했다.)

He continued, "If the investigation reveals that forced drinking and the disregard of the inspectorial request are true, we will impose the maximum possible accountability, including disciplinary action, criminal punishment, civil damages, and subsequent indemnity claims, so that workplace abuses like dinners, forced drinking, corruption, and cover-ups can never even be dreamed of in this country again." (이어 “조사 결과 음주 강요와 감찰 조사 요구 묵살이 사실로 드러나면 징계는 물론 형사 처벌에 민사 손해배상 후 구상 청구까지 할 수 있는 최대치의 문책을 해서, 다시는 이 나라에서 회식, 음주 강요 같은 직장 내 악성 갑질이나 부정부패, 은폐 묵살은 꿈도 꿀 수 없도록 하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: NEC Admits Vote Counting Errors in Both 2024 General Election and Local Elections; Failed to Correct for Two Years (선관위 2024년 총선 때도 개표 오류...후보자에는 알리고 2년 째 정정 안해)
item.description:
NEC Admits Vote Counting Errors in Both 2024 General Election and Local Elections; Failed to Correct for Two Years (선관위 2024년 총선 때도 개표 오류...후보자에는 알리고 2년 째 정정 안해)

Amid the vote count input error that occurred during the counting process for the North Jeolla Province Superintendent of Education election in the June 3 nationwide local elections, it has been revealed that the National Election Commission (NEC) also incorrectly entered the vote counting results for the 22nd National Assembly general election. <<> According to a comprehensive report by this newspaper on the 11th, the Gyeonggi Provincial Election Commission and the Suwon Yeongtong District Election Commission incorrectly entered the vote counting results for the Gyeonggi Suwonjeong constituency during the 22nd general election held on May 10, 2024. In that election, Democratic Party of Korea candidate Kim Jun-hyeok and People Power Party candidate Lee Soo-jeong faced off, with Kim winning 69,811 votes (50.87%) and Lee 67,504 votes (49.13%), giving Kim a victory by a margin of 2,377 votes. <<> However, it was not until June 26, two months after the election, that the NEC notified the candidates of the error in the vote counts. It turned out that Kim had actually received 70,970 votes (50.83%), and Lee 68,656 votes (49.17%). <<> This error stemmed from a misreporting of invalid votes. At the time, the NEC initially reported 4,696 invalid votes, but later corrected that the actual invalid votes were 2,455. Of the 2,241 votes mistakenly recorded as invalid, 1,089 were for Kim and 1,152 for Lee. In an official document, the NEC stated, "This was not the final vote count result; it was a mistaken input of the results sorted by the ballot scanner before the invalid votes were corrected to valid votes, so the pre-correction figures were reflected." <<> Lee Soo-jeong, currently the chair of the People Power Party's Suwonjeong district party committee, said in a phone interview with this newspaper, "Two months later, an NEC staff member visited and said they had incorrectly entered the vote count. Since the outcome didn't change, I signed the confirmation and let it go." She added, "Seeing what's happening now, I think I was too complacent and didn't raise the issue at the time." <<> The problem is that the NEC has still not corrected the vote count. The NEC has stated that because a lawsuit challenging the validity of the election for that constituency has been filed with the Supreme Court, it plans to correct the vote count results only after the lawsuit concludes. <<> Meanwhile, in this local election, a vote count input error also occurred during the counting for the North Jeolla Province Superintendent of Education election. In the election held on the 3rd, a mistake in recording the voting log from the 3rd polling station in Junghwasan 1-dong, Wansan-gu, Jeonju, under the entry for the 1st polling station led to the omission of the vote count results for 1,104 voters from the 1st polling station. Kim Sang-gon, head of the North Jeolla Provincial Election Commission, apologized on the 11th, saying, "We are deeply sorry." (이번 6·3 전국동시지방선거 전북교육감 개표 과정에서 득표수 입력 오류 사고가 벌어진 가운데 중앙선거관리위원회가 지난 22대 국회의원 총선에서도 개표 결과를 잘못 입력했던 것으로 나타났다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Nominee Han Sung-sook Reports Assets of 25 Billion Won: Three Houses, 10 Billion Won in Deposits, 2 Billion Won in Overseas Stocks (한성숙 총리 후보자, 재산 250억원 신고… 집 3채, 예금 100억, 해외주식 20억)
item.description:
Prime Minister Nominee Han Sung-sook Reports Assets of 25 Billion Won: Three Houses, 10 Billion Won in Deposits, 2 Billion Won in Overseas Stocks (한성숙 총리 후보자, 재산 250억원 신고… 집 3채, 예금 100억, 해외주식 20억)

Prime Minister nominee Han Sung-sook has reportedly disposed of all her virtual assets and plans to sell all her overseas stocks within this month. (한성숙 국무총리 후보자가 보유한 가상 자산을 모두 처분했고, 해외 주식도 이달 안으로 모두 매각하기로 한 것으로 알려졌다.)

According to a request for personnel hearing submitted to the National Assembly by President Lee Jae-myung on the 11th, as of this month, Han reported owning assets totaling 25.3901 billion won in her name and her mother's. Han's personal assets amount to 25.0882 billion won, including 3.06648 billion won in real estate, 10.32387 billion won in deposits, and 2.06583 billion won in stocks. This is an increase of 2.70725 billion won from the 22.3157 billion won reported at the end of last year. (11일 이재명 대통령이 국회에 낸 한 후보자 인사청문 요청안에 따르면, 한 후보자는 이달 기준 본인과 어머니 명의 재산으로 253억9010만원을 갖고 있다고 신고했다. 한 후보자 본인 명의 재산은 부동산 30억6648만원, 예금 103억2387만원, 주식 20억6583만원 등 250억882만원이다. 지난해 말 기준 신고액 223억157만원보다 27억725만원 늘었다.)

Han reported owning a detached house in Samcheong-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul, with a dedicated area of 221.93 square meters (about 67 pyeong), a detached house in Yangseo-myeon, Yangpyeong-gun, Gyeonggi Province, with 187.38 square meters (about 57 pyeong), and a detached house in Gwangsadong, Yangju-si, Gyeonggi Province, with 37.3 square meters (about 11 pyeong). Their values are stated as 1.5 billion won, 630 million won, and 6.97 million won, respectively. (한 후보자는 서울 종로구 삼청동에 전용 면적 221.93㎡(약 67평)짜리 단독주택, 경기 양평군 양서면에 187.38㎡(약 57평)짜리 단독주택, 경기 양주시 광사동에 37.3㎡(약 11평)짜리 단독주택을 갖고 있다고 신고했다. 가액은 각각 15억원, 6억3000만원, 697만원이라고 했다.)

She reported selling the Asia Athletes' Village apartment in Jamsil-dong, Songpa-gu, Seoul, measuring 151.01 square meters (about 46 pyeong). Han is known to have held this apartment for 20 years, earning nearly 3 billion won in capital gains. (서울 송파구 잠실동 아시아선수촌아파트 151.01㎡(약 46평)는 팔았다고 신고했다. 한 후보자는 이 아파트를 20년간 보유해 30억원 가까운 차익을 얻은 것으로 알려졌다.)

Additionally, Han reported owning an officetel in Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul (2.07463 billion won), a neighborhood living facility in Yeongeon-dong, Jongno-gu (1.4 billion won), another neighborhood living facility (890 million won), and an office in Samcheong-dong, Jongno-gu (500 million won). Among these, she has listed the officetel for sale. (한 후보자는 이 밖에도 서울 강남구 역삼동 오피스텔(20억7463만원), 종로구 연건동 근린생활시설(14억원), 다른 근린생활시설(8억9000만원), 종로구 삼청동 사무실(5억원)을 갖고 있다고 신고했다. 한 후보자는 이 가운데 오피스텔을 매물로 내놨다.)

As of the end of last year, Han reported holding virtual assets such as Bitcoin and Ethereum worth 20.29 million won, but after selling some, she reported having 13.77 million won worth this month. However, a Prime Minister's Office official stated, "Han has sold all remaining virtual assets and currently holds none." (한 후보자는 지난해 말 기준 비트코인·이더리움 등 가상 자산을 2029만원어치 갖고 있다고 신고했으나, 일부를 매각해 이달 기준으로 1377만원어치 갖고 있다고 신고했다. 그러나 총리실 관계자는 “한 후보자가 나머지 가상 자산도 모두 매각해 현재는 갖고 있지 않다”고 했다.)

Han also reported owning stocks in Apple, Tesla, Nvidia, Palantir, American Express, Nike, and others, as well as U.S. stocks like the Invesco QQQ Trust and Vanguard 500 Index Fund, either directly or through ETFs, totaling 2.10865 billion won. (한 후보자는 또 애플·테슬라·엔비디아·팔란티어·아메리칸익스프레스·나이키 등 주식과 인베스코QQQ트러스트·뱅가드500인덱스펀드 등 미국 주식을 직접 또는 ETF로 21억865만원어치 갖고 있다고 신고했다.)

However, the Prime Minister's Office official said, "Han plans to sell all overseas stocks as early as this week, or at the latest by the end of this month." (그러나 총리실 관계자는 “한 후보자가 해외 주식을 이르면 이번 주 내로, 늦어도 이달 안으로 모두 매도할 예정”이라고 했다.)

When Han was a candidate for Minister of SMEs and Startups last year, she sold all her domestic stocks and currently holds no domestic stocks. (한 후보자는 지난해 중소벤처기업부 장관 후보자가 됐을 때 국내 주식을 전량 매도해, 국내 주식은 갖고 있지 않다.)

item.title: Prime Minister Kim: "If This Is How It's Going to Be, Might as Well Dissolve the Election Commission" (金총리 “선관위, 이럴 거면 해체하는 게 낫지 않나”)
item.description:
Prime Minister Kim: "If This Is How It's Going to Be, Might as Well Dissolve the Election Commission" (金총리 “선관위, 이럴 거면 해체하는 게 낫지 않나”)

Prime Minister Kim Min-seok stated on the 11th regarding the shortage of ballots during the June 3 local elections, "If this is how it's going to be, it might be better to just dissolve the National Election Commission." In response to some participants at the Jamsil voting rights protest who privately questioned or insulted police officers and other citizens, he said, "This is a violation of democratic order," and added, "We will respond strictly and consistently to the end." (김민석 국무총리는 11일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련해 “이럴 거라면 선거관리위원회는 차라리 해체하는 게 낫지 않나”라고 말했다. 서울 잠실 참정권 침해 집회 참가자 일부가 경찰관이나 다른 시민들을 사적으로 검문하거나 모욕한 데 대해서는 “민주 질서 침해”라며 “끝까지 원칙적으로 대응하겠다”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim made these remarks during an evening meeting titled "Meeting of Ministers on the Infringement of Citizens' Voting Rights" held at the Government Complex Sejong. (김 총리는 이날 저녁 정부세종청사에서 ‘국민 참정권 침해 관련 관계 장관 회의’를 열고 이같이 말했다.)

Prime Minister Kim stated, "The unprecedented infringement of citizens' voting rights that occurred during the June 3 local elections is dragging on, and public concern is growing," adding, "17 universities nationwide have issued a joint declaration on the national situation, and demands for condemnation of the Election Commission and institutional reform are pouring in from all walks of life." (김 총리는 “6·3 지방선거 과정에서 생긴 사상 초유의 국민 참정권 침해 사태가 길어지고 국민 우려도 커져가고 있다”며 “전국 17개 대학이 공동 시국선언을 했고, 각계각층에서도 선관위에 대한 규탄과 제도 개선 요구가 빗발치고 있다”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim first criticized the fact that the ballot storage box from the Jamsil 7-dong 2nd polling station, which the court ordered to be preserved as evidence the previous day, had already been discarded before the court order, saying, "It seems the Election Commission still does not fully grasp the severity of the situation." (김 총리는 먼저 전날 법원이 증거로 보전하라고 명령한 잠실7동 제2투표소 투표용지 보관 상자가 법원 명령 전에 이미 폐기돼 있는 것과 관련해 “선관위가 아직도 사태 심각성을 제대로 인식하지 못하고 있는 것 같다”고 비판했다.)

Prime Minister Kim said, "If this is how it's going to be, it might be better to just dissolve the Election Commission," and added, "There is no doubt that there are voices from the public saying that if the Election Commission operates like this, it should be dissolved." He also stated, "The Election Commission must undergo a complete awakening from top to bottom." (김 총리는 “이럴 거라면 선관위는 차라리 해체하는 게 낫지 않나”라며 “선관위가 이런 식이라면 해체돼야 한다는 국민 목소리가 틀림없이 있다”고 했다. “선관위는 위부터 아래까지 대오각성해야 한다”고도 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim then mentioned that the ruling and opposition parties each submitted requests for a parliamentary investigation, which were reported to the National Assembly plenary session that afternoon, and said, "Regardless of partisan or political interests, I ask the ruling and opposition parties to swiftly discuss forming a special committee (for the parliamentary investigation) to strengthen democracy, and to lead a thorough uncovering of the truth and discussions on institutional improvements." (김 총리는 이어서 여야가 각각 낸 국정조사 요구서가 이날 오후 국회 본회의에 보고된 것을 거론하면서 “이 문제는 정파나 정치적 이해관계를 떠나 여야가 민주주의 공고화를 위해 (국정조사) 특별위원회 구성을 신속하게 협의해 주시고, 철저한 진상 규명과 제도 개선 논의를 이끌어 주시기 바란다”고 했다.)

He added, "The government will also actively cooperate in all necessary areas." To the prosecution and police, he said, "I ask that the joint investigation headquarters lead the investigation as swiftly and strictly as possible." (그러면서 “정부도 필요한 모든 부분에 적극 협력하겠다”고 했다. 검찰과 경찰에는 “합동수사본부를 중심으로 해서 최대한 신속하고 엄정하게 수사되도록 해 달라”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, regarding the Jamsil voting rights protest, Prime Minister Kim stated, "While infringement of voting rights is unacceptable, violations of democratic order are also not to be tolerated." Addressing some protest participants who 'searched' police officers or citizens without authorization, he said, "By what right do you block citizens' free passage or entry, detain police officers, and slander or curse at passing citizens? Who has the right to do such things?" (김 총리는 한편 잠실 참정권 집회와 관련해 “참정권 침해도 용납할 수 없는 일이지만, 민주 질서 침해 또한 용납돼선 안 된다”고 했다. 김 총리는 집회 참가자 일부가 경찰관이나 시민들을 무단으로 ‘검문’한 것 등에 대해 “무슨 권리로 시민들의 자유로운 통행이나 출입을 막고, 경찰관들을 감금하고, 지나가는 시민을 비방하고 욕설하느냐”며 “그렇게 할 권리가 누구에게 있느냐”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim said, "Under the pretext of legitimate demands from citizens to rectify voting rights violations, and by exploiting the public's demand to protect democracy, actions that instead seek to destroy democratic order and democracy can never be tolerated." He added, "I ask relevant ministries to thoroughly identify illegal activities under a zero-tolerance principle and respond with the mindset of ensuring such acts never take place." (김 총리는 “참정권 침해를 시정하기 위한 국민의 정당한 요구를 빌미로, 민주주의를 지켜야 한다는 국민 요구를 악용해서, 오히려 민주 질서와 민주주의를 파괴하려는 행위는 절대로 용납될 수 없다”고 했다. 그러면서 “관련 부처는 무관용의 원칙으로 (불법 행위를) 끝까지 파악하고, 절대로 그런 일이 이뤄질 수 없도록 해야 한다는 생각으로 대응해 주기 바란다”고 했다.)

Prime Minister Kim reiterated, "While responsibility must be taken for the infringement of voting rights, responsibility must also be taken for violations of democratic order." He said, "The government will humbly accept legitimate concerns and discussions, but will respond strictly and consistently to anti-democratic behavior that causes inconvenience to citizens." (김 총리는 다시 “참정권 침해도 책임져야 하지만, 민주 질서 침해도 반드시 책임을 져야 할 것”이라고 했다. 김 총리는 “정부는 정당한 문제 제기와 논의에 대해서는 겸허한 자세로 수용하겠지만, 시민에게 불편을 끼치는 반민주적 행태에 대해서는 끝까지 원칙적으로 대응하겠다”고 했다.)

Attending the meeting were senior officials from administrative agencies supporting the elections, including Kim Jeong-woo, Director of the Cheong Wa Dae National Situation Room; Choi Gyo-jin, Minister of Education; Jeong Seong-ho, Minister of Justice; Choi Hwi-young, Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism; Kim Jong-cheol, Chairman of the Broadcasting and Media Communication Commission; Yun Chang-ryeol, Director of the Office for Government Policy Coordination; and Kim Min-jae, Vice Minister of the Ministry of the Interior and Safety.
